title: Update state fails when resuming subgraph after interrupt
observed_behavior: A parent graph routes to a compiled tech-support subgraph whose parse node calls interrupt(). On resume the caller sends Command(update={'message': 'This is a problem description'}, resume=True). Inside the resumed subgraph node, state['message'] is still the original 'Hi, I've a technical issue'; the update appears only after the node terminates. The top-level graph is said to behave as documented, but the subgraph does not.
structure_focus: Command(update=..., resume=...) through a parent/subgraph boundary; when the update becomes visible to the resumed node
notes: Open at collection; maintainer reply says the top-level behavior works but the subgraph case does not, recommends Command(resume=value), and says they will investigate. Classified framework: the same resume API behaves inconsistently when the interrupted node is inside a compiled subgraph. The fixture keeps the input_schema/state_schema split, the compiled tech-support child with interrupt, and the resume call with both update and resume.
